title: SAP Business Partner
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

SAP Business Partner

The SAP Business Partner represents an organization (company, branch), person, or group of persons or organizations in which
your company has a business interest.

Business partners used in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable must exist in the Contract Partner role MKK.
You can enter and manage your business partners centrally with regard to different business transactions.
This is particularly useful if a business partner plays different roles in an enterprise, such as a payer as well as a service recipient.

A business partner can be created in various business partner roles and can assume additional business partner roles during the
course of the business relationship. You do not have to enter the general data for a business partner each time, which avoids
redundant data entry and retention.

Structure

The following basic elements are available in the business partner data:

Concept                                                                                                        Comment

Business partner category                                                             The data available for your business transactions depends on the
business partner category.

Business partner role                                                                  A business partner can take on different business partner roles,
which enable different views of the business partner data
depending on the business function.

Business partner relationship                                                      A relationship connects two business partners and is identified by
the business partner relationship category .

Business partner group hierarchy                                                 You can use the business partner group hierarchy to represent the
structure of an organization.

Related Information

SAP Business Partner

Business Partner in the Contract Partner Role (MKK)

Use

You use the business partner in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable in the role of the contract partner (MKK).

A contract partner is connected with the company through contract accounts and through the conclusion of contracts. Contract
accounts can therefore only be assigned to a business partner and services billed accordingly if you have created this business
partner in the role of contract partner in the business role MKK for role category MKK.
